title: Ghost v7C ResFormerSparse + LeakyReLU² + LaCT experimental submission
author: lock757
body:
Experimental / non-record submission due to late GPU-credit availability.

I received GPU credit approval today while at work, so full 8xH100 validation logs are still pending. This PR is submitted as an experimental/non-record branch unless full official logs are later added and accepted.

This initial commit may include the emergency package upload while I continue correcting the folder placement.

This branch packages Ghost v7C with:
- sparse ResFormer-style value residual learning
- LeakyReLU(0.5)^2 MLP activation
- LaCT-style score-first TTT path
- no-QV TTT mask
- corrected quant/dequant roundtrip
- clean export before TTT to avoid validation-adapted model leakage
- corrected per-token sliding-window eval
- CPU micro-simulation report for core mechanics

No leaderboard record is claimed without official 8xH100 logs.
